text: The Orbitrap mass analyzer achieves resolving power up to 500,000 and mass accuracy under 1 ppm by trapping ions in an electrostatic field and measuring the frequency of their image current as they rotate.
explanation: True. Ions are trapped in an electrostatic field around a central electrode, and the frequency of their orbital rotation, which is proportional to m/z, is detected via image current, giving the Orbitrap its industry-leading resolving power and sub-ppm mass accuracy.
